personas.ai_literacy_level: Medium: Basic understanding of generative AI tools and some familiarity with common indicators of AI-generated content. Can occasionally identify synthetic patterns but may miss subtle cues.
personas.prior_ai_use: Frequent: Regularly uses AI systems across multiple contexts and is highly familiar with their outputs, strengths, and limitations.
personas.online_content_skepticism: Low: Generally accepts online content at face value and rarely questions authenticity unless obvious issues are present.
personas.attention_to_detail: High: Carefully analyses wording, structure, visual elements, and contextual consistency before making a judgement.
personas.prior_exposure_to_misinformation: Low: Limited prior exposure to misinformation or manipulated media discussions.
